name: Visual Boy Advance GX
author: Tantric, dborth
description_short: Game Boy Advance, Game Boy Color, and Game Boy emulator for GameCube based on VBA-M.
description_long: Plays GBA, GBC, and original Game Boy ROMs on GameCube. Supports SRAM and state saving, IPS/UPS patches, custom controller configurations, turbo speed, video zooming, widescreen, unfiltered video, fixed pixel ratio modes, custom borders, 240p output, native Goomba ROM/SRAM loading, editable 14-colour palettes for monochrome games, and more.

license.notes: Repository README states "Under GPL License"; project is a port of VBA-M which is GPL-2.0-or-later. No top-level LICENSE file in the repo.
